recipes.title: Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Authentic Neapolitan pizza with fresh basil, mozzarella, and rich tomato sauce.
recipes.instructions:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water and combine with flour and salt to form dough.
2. Let dough rise for 1 hour.
3. Roll out dough, spread tomato sauce, and layer fresh mozzarella slices.
4. Bake at 240°C (460°F) for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden.
5. Top with fresh basil and drizzle olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Creamy Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Rich and velvety North Indian curry made with tender chicken pieces in a spiced tomato-butter sauce.
recipes.instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for at least 30 mins.
2. Sear chicken pieces in a hot skillet until charred.
3. Prepare gravy by cooking butter, garlic, tomato puree, and spices.
4. Stir in cream and cooked chicken. Simmer for 10 mins.
5. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with naan.

recipes.title: Avocado & Quinoa Power Bowl
recipes.description: Nutritious and vibrant vegan bowl packed with superfoods, roasted chickpeas, and tahini dressing.
recipes.instructions:
1. Arrange cooked quinoa and fresh spinach in a bowl.
2. Top with sliced avocado, roasted chickpeas, and halved cherry tomatoes.
3. Whisk tahini, lemon juice, and 1 tbsp water to make dressing.
4. Drizzle dressing over the bowl and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Crispy Masala Dosa
recipes.description: Thin golden crisp rice crepe filled with fragrant spiced potatoes and served with coconut chutney.
recipes.instructions:
1. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in hot oil, then sauté onions and spiced potatoes.
2. Ladle batter onto a preheated griddle and spread thin with circular motions.
3. Drizzle ghee along the edges until golden and crispy.
4. Place potato masala in center, fold tight and serve hot with coconut chutney.

recipes.title: Sadza and Grilled Fish
recipes.description: Classic Zimbabwean feast of smooth white sadza, seasoned tilapia, and fresh leafy greens.
recipes.instructions:
1. Stir cornmeal into boiling water continuously until thick smooth dough forms.
2. Season tilapia with lemon pepper, herbs, and grill over medium hot coals.
3. Sauté greens with onions and tomatoes until tender.
4. Serve warm sadza with grilled fish and seasoned greens.

recipes.title: Street Style Tacos
recipes.description: Warm corn tortillas piled high with flame-grilled seasoned meat, fresh cilantro, and salsa verde.
recipes.instructions:
1. Marinate steak with taco seasoning and citrus juice for 20 mins.
2. Flame-grill steak on high heat until charred, then dice into small bites.
3. Warm corn tortillas on a dry skillet.
4. Layer meat onto double tortillas, top with onion, cilantro, and squeeze of fresh lime.

recipes.title: Authentic Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: Szechuan stir-fry dish with tender chicken cubes, roasted peanuts, and vibrant chili peppers.
recipes.instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with soy sauce and cornstarch for 15 mins.
2. Heat wok, stir-fry dried chilis and peppercorns until fragrant.
3. Add chicken and stir-fry until golden brown.
4. Toss in peanuts, green onions, and sauce mixture. Stir until glossy and hot.

recipes.title: Decadent Chocolate Lava Cake
recipes.description: Warm individual chocolate cakes with a gooey flowing molten center, served with vanilla bean ice cream.
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt dark chocolate and butter over a water bath until smooth.
2. Whisk eggs, yolks, and powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
3. Fold melted chocolate and flour gently into egg mixture.
4. Pour into buttered ramekins and bake at 220°C (425°F) for 12 mins.
5. Invert onto plate and serve immediately with ice cream.

recipes.title: Berry Blast Antioxidant Smoothie
recipes.description: Refreshing and energizing blend of strawberries, blueberries, Greek yogurt, and honey.
ingredients: 1 cup Mixed frozen berries (Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries)
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine frozen berries, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey in a high-speed blender.
2. Blend on high for 60 seconds until completely smooth.
3. Pour into chilled glass, sprinkle chia seeds on top, and enjoy with a straw.
